findings.summary: Conditional static-number selection for query-derived MSAA options duplicated option-folding logic; it now lives in the shared option helper and accepts only the reached 1/4 sample counts.

Sprite vertex permutations were emitted through repeated positional calls and depth-only scenes still deployed the pure-2D vertex stage; emission now uses one options table and independently gates pure and depth-hosted stages.
Depth-enabled layers could enter a standalone SpriteRenderer whose pass has no depth attachment; compiler and native creation/addition paths now reject that invalid ownership shape.
The consolidated sprite_2d.cpp provenance omitted the reached sprite-scene, sprite-renderable, and alpha-to-coverage origins; generated provenance and regression coverage now include them.
SDL_GPU and Dawn repeated backend-neutral sprite fixed-state planning; both now consume one shared SpriteLayerPipelinePlan and compatibility predicate.
Any sprite instance mutation uploaded the full active layer; generated mutators now accumulate dirty ranges and both PALs perform offset/range uploads with multi-consumer recovery.
Dawn allocated and rewrote two identical layer uniform buffers; both bind groups now share one buffer whose payload is written only when it changes.

Layers sharing an atlas duplicated GPU textures and samplers, and SDL initially retained unused cache entries after membership churn; each pass now owns one atlas binding per handle and prunes unused standalone entries.

Runtime UV-scroll widening and alpha-to-coverage changes could leave an already-created pipeline stale; both PALs now snapshot pipeline state and rebuild or reselect compatible pipelines before upload.

Sprite depth metadata reused the compiler's real static-string field, turning handles returned through records into strings in freeciv and platformer; a dedicated handle metadata field now survives record/array flows and is reconciled across conditionals and nullable assignments.
